mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over a 3-month period indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and decreases in the unemployment rate signal an overheating economy with rising inflationary pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp and UNRATE falls by >0.1pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a housing starts rate below 1.2 million units per month signals a contraction in residential investment and weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1200 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing and services output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A core CPI annual rate exceeding 3.0% indicates persistent inflationary pressures, leading the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual rate exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong growth in retail sales (above 0.5% monthly) and payroll employment (above 150k per month) indicates robust consumer spending and a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.5% indicates a weakening economy and potential recession, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth falls below 1.5% during late-cycle expansions.
